title: PhpStorm 2026.3 Adds an Agent Workspace and PHP 8.6 Support
content:
PhpStorm 2026.3 adds PHP 8.6 support, new Laravel inspections, a Processes tab for queue workers, and Air, a workspace for coding agents.

The post PhpStorm 2026.3 Adds an Agent Workspace and PHP 8.6 Support appeared first on Laravel News.
